entries.title: Mark 4:1
segments: And again he began to teach by the sea side. And there is gathered unto him a very great multitude, so that he entered into a boat, and sat in the sea; and all the multitude were by the sea on the land.

entries.title: Mark 4:2
segments: And he taught them many things in parables, and said unto them in his teaching,

entries.title: Mark 4:3
segments: Hearken: Behold, the sower went forth to sow:

entries.title: Mark 4:4
segments: and it came to pass, as he sowed, some [seed] fell by the way side, and the birds came and devoured it.

entries.title: Mark 4:5
segments: And other fell on the rocky [ground], where it had not much earth; and straightway it sprang up, because it had no deepness of earth:

entries.title: Mark 4:6
segments: and when the sun was risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

entries.title: Mark 4:7
segments: And other fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

entries.title: Mark 4:8
segments: And others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing; and brought forth, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.

entries.title: Mark 4:9
segments: And he said, Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.title: Mark 4:10
segments: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parables.

entries.title: Mark 4:11
segments: And he said unto them, Unto you is given the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all things are done in parables:

entries.title: Mark 4:12
segments: that seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest haply they should turn again, and it should be forgiven them.

entries.title: Mark 4:13
segments: And he saith unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how shall ye know all the parables?

entries.title: Mark 4:14
segments: The sower soweth the word.

entries.title: Mark 4:15
segments: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; and when they have heard, straightway cometh Satan, and taketh away the word which hath been sown in them.

entries.title: Mark 4:16
segments: And these in like manner are they that are sown upon the rocky [places], who, when they have heard the word, straightway receive it with joy;

entries.title: Mark 4:17
segments: and they have no root in themselves, but endure for a while; then, when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway they stumble.

entries.title: Mark 4:18
segments: And others are they that are sown among the thorns; these are they that have heard the word,

entries.title: Mark 4:19
segments: and the cares of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

entries.title: Mark 4:20
segments: And those are they that were sown upon the good ground; such as hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, thirtyfold, and sixtyfold, and a hundredfold.

entries.title: Mark 4:21
segments: And he said unto them, Is the lamp brought to be put under the bushel, or under the bed, [and] not to be put on the stand?

entries.title: Mark 4:22
segments: For there is nothing hid, save that it should be manifested; neither was [anything] made secret, but that it should come to light.

entries.title: Mark 4:23
segments: If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.

entries.title: Mark 4:24
segments: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete it shall be measured unto you; and more shall be given unto you.

entries.title: Mark 4:25
segments: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.

entries.title: Mark 4:26
segments: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed upon the earth;

entries.title: Mark 4:27
segments: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he knoweth not how.

entries.title: Mark 4:28
segments: The earth beareth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

entries.title: Mark 4:29
segments: But when the fruit is ripe, straightway he putteth forth the sickle, because the harvest is come.

entries.title: Mark 4:30
segments: And he said, How shall we liken the kingdom of God? or in what parable shall we set it forth?

entries.title: Mark 4:31
segments: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown upon the earth, though it be less than all the seeds that are upon the earth,

entries.title: Mark 4:32
segments: yet when it is sown, groweth up, and becometh greater than all the herbs, and putteth out great branches; so that the birds of the heaven can lodge under the shadow thereof.

entries.title: Mark 4:33
segments: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it;

entries.title: Mark 4:34
segments: and without a parable spake he not unto them: but privately to his own disciples he expounded all things.

entries.title: Mark 4:35
segments: And on that day, when even was come, he saith unto them, Let us go over unto the other side.

entries.title: Mark 4:36
segments: And leaving the multitude, they take him with them, even as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.

entries.title: Mark 4:37
segments: And there ariseth a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, insomuch that the boat was now filling.

entries.title: Mark 4:38
segments: And he himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion: and they awake him, and say unto him, Teacher, carest thou not that we perish?

entries.title: Mark 4:39
segments: And he awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

entries.title: Mark 4:40
segments: And he said unto them, Why are ye fearful? have ye not yet faith?

entries.title: Mark 4:41
segments: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
